name: Contradiction detection
description: Directly contradicting statements should trigger conflict resolution

name: Preference update
description: Changing a preference should update the existing memory

steps.store: My favorite editor is VS Code
I switched to Cursor, it's my favorite editor now

name: Location change
description: Moving to a new city should update or contradict the old location

name: Job change
description: Changing employer should update the existing work memory

steps.store: I work at Google as a software engineer
I just joined Meta as a tech lead

name: Relationship status change
description: Relationship changes should update existing memory

steps.store: I just started dating someone named Alex

name: Diet change
description: Dietary preference changes should be detected

steps.store: I started eating meat again recently

name: Hobby replacement
description: Replacing a hobby should be detected as a conflict

steps.store: I quit tennis and now I play pickleball instead

name: Numeric update
description: Updating numbers (age, years of experience) should be caught

steps.store: I now have 8 years of experience
